items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 二 in a Western Zhou bronze-script form, sourced to 免簋. The two strokes express the numeral directly.
items.alt: A modern vector rendering of two horizontal bronze-script strokes representing 二.
items.selection_reason: The file page identifies the script tradition, source context, specific Xiaoxuetang form, and CC0 reuse status; it illustrates the direct two-stroke numeral graph.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw rather than a photograph or scan of the bronze object. The source page links it to 免簋 and a Xiaoxuetang form record, but no artifact image was inspected here.
The ancient graphic sequence and earliest dated attestation remain unverified; this single example should not be read as a complete developmental timeline.
